files.description: Hotel bookings (300 rows): booking_id (whole number), state (paid, cancelled, refunded or pending; mostly lower case, some with other capitals or extra spaces), total (booking amount, two decimals; refunded bookings are negative), nights (whole number; about 2% empty).

task_text: Normalise the state labels of the bookings (lower case, no surrounding spaces) and then rename the state 'pending' to 'open'. `result` should be the updated bookings table with all columns, in file order.
intended_computation: Strip and lower-case state, replace 'pending' by 'open' and return all 300 bookings with their four columns in file order.

predicted_direction.reason: on 2.x the replacement with the in-place flag returns None, which becomes the answer; 3.x returns the table
